name: Saltmere
author: Aimon base campaign
_hubNote: Hand-authored, permanent, six rooms. The only place in the game not generated. Rooms use world coordinates like everywhere else; the Hub cube is reserved at 0,0,0 before anything else is allocated.

rooms.name: The Guild Yard
rooms.baseDesc: Flagstones worn into shallow bowls by boots that came back, and by boots that came back changed. A board by the arch carries notices, most of them out of date. The gate stands open onto the road east.

rooms.name: The Long Hall
rooms.baseDesc: Trestle tables, a fire that is never quite out, and a wall of hooks where people hang what they do not want to carry. Someone has scratched a tally into the beam above the hearth and stopped counting.

rooms.name: Marda's Counter
rooms.baseDesc: A counter of scarred oak, racks behind it, and a smell of oil and cold iron. Nothing here is new. Most of it has been sold twice.

rooms.name: The Strongroom
rooms.baseDesc: A short room with a long ledger and a door that is thicker than it needs to be. The clerk does not look up until you put something on the desk.

rooms.name: The Training Post
rooms.baseDesc: A stump, a pell, and a rack of blunt practice gear that has been repaired more often than replaced. The ground here does not grow anything any more.

rooms.name: The Roadgate
rooms.baseDesc: The arch, the road, and a milestone with the top third broken off. Whatever it used to say about distances, it does not say now.

npcs.name: Marda
npcs.persona: human, quartermaster, glowing with a maternal glow, always smiling

npcs.name: Lizzy
npcs.persona: lizardfolk, storeroom clerk, kind and curious, anal about order and labels

npcs.name: Miranda
npcs.persona: human, master-at-arms, proud and powerful, ex-knight with a dark secret

starterKit._note: Issued at character creation AND after every defeat. Tagged untradable so it cannot be farmed and sold.

characterCreation._rerollNote: Two full rerolls. Attributes never rise in play, so a hopeless spread is a dead campaign, not a challenge.

archetypes.name: Freebooter
archetypes.blurb: Hits hard, stands up, talks later.

archetypes.name: Cutpurse
archetypes.blurb: Fast, sharp-eyed, better at leaving than arriving.

archetypes.name: Just roll
archetypes.blurb: Take what the dice give you.

characterCreation._archetypeNote: An archetype does not change the roll. It swaps the two highest results into the favoured attributes and picks the opening kit — a nudge for a first-time player, not a class.
